sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Duo Water and Fire are centered around navigating through levels as the brotherly duo Fire and Water. Each character has unique abilities that allow them to overcome obstacles and challenges in their own way. Fire can pass through red water, while Water can pass through blue water. However, neither character can pass through green water, which requires careful planning and execution to overcome.

The gameplay is divided into three main components: collecting keys, collecting gold, and reaching the door. Collecting keys is a crucial part of the game, as it allows you to unlock new levels and progress through the game.
